scope: Constructed eight evidence-pinned theory passports over one fixed six-stage route from foundational assumptions through state space, dynamics, observable and prediction to an empirical benchmark. Four routes reach bounded data comparisons; four expose their first missing bridge. Stage-local evidence remains visible after an upstream blocker, while joins and claim flags prevent isolated results from being promoted to a complete theory.

human-readable passport table, blockers and source trail
content-addressed static-site manifest with the Theory journeys view
site result exposing the passport atlas without changing evidence grades
paper authority and RF-82 passport claim registration
independent paper, appendix, passport-count and boundary verifier

tier_2.criterion: The new result schema and generated atlas affect the website and paper certificate chain. The atlas producer/checker, site producer/checker, viability and assembly direct consumers, appendix generator, paper authority map and compiled PDF were rebuilt and checked. All seven scientific source artifacts were unchanged and accepted only by their recorded content hashes; their expensive producer chains were therefore not rerun.

tier_3.criterion: No classical or quantum freeze/tag, theorem or lifecycle promotion, shared core-algebra change, release, or explicit full-suite request is involved.

does_not_establish: that stage functions have identical mathematical realizations across competing frameworks
that a stage-local result composes through an open join
that a bounded empirical pass validates a complete theory
that a bounded empirical failure universally refutes a programme
a new Lorentzian, quantum, continuum, positivity or QME result
a promotion of any completion-matrix evidence grade
